components.stylesheet: web/style.css + profiles-v2.css + work-v4.css + investor.css + edition.css + icons.css, in build order (scripts/observatory.py)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: body, the sticky topbar, dialogs, compare table cells. The ground every text token is checked on. ink reads 15.2:1, muted 5.8:1, green 7.4:1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Open filter panels and the noscript notice. Same value as bg; the source keeps both names, so keep them in step.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, the wordmark, the current nav item, pay figures. On bg 15.2:1, on field 16.0:1, on band-group 14.2:1.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: intros, labels, captions, kickers, inactive nav, historical figures, table row labels. On bg 5.8:1, on band 5.5:1, on band-group and hover 5.4:1, on track 5.1:1.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The one brand hue. Links, the primary button fill, the current nav and tab underline, chart bars, the focus ring, checkbox accent, live revenue figures. As text on bg 7.4:1, on band 7.0:1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: An older name for green that the source still declares. Only a legacy profile tab rule reads it. Reach for green.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every 1px hairline: row dividers, column rules, the topbar edge, bordered buttons. Decorative at 1.3:1 on bg, so a control never relies on it alone.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The same hairline under the profile stylesheet's name. Reach for border.

tokens.name: pale
tokens.usage: Light fills: the publisher's venture band, the overview safety note, the first search result, the evidence dialog's metric panel and the evidence copy button on hover. The same value also paints the light logo plates as a literal. ink 14.2:1, muted 5.4:1, green 6.9:1 on it.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warm accent: the 3px left rule of the paid work safety note, the text and 1px border of observation tags on profile figures, and the audit note text in the first stylesheet. 5.7:1 on bg, 6.0:1 on field.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on green, green-dark and tray (primary button label, tray link). 7.9:1 on green, 12.5:1 on tray.

tokens.name: green-dark
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover; on-green reads 11.7:1 on it. The business health dashboard uses the same green as its dark accent (--bh-dark) and for chart value labels.

tokens.name: tray
tokens.usage: Ground of the fixed compare tray. bg text reads 11.7:1 on it, on-green 12.5:1. Its controls hover to green and take a bg focus ring, since the green ring reads only 1.6:1 here.

tokens.name: tray-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of the Clear button on the compare tray. 4.9:1 on tray, 3.1:1 on the green hover fill.

tokens.name: logo-dark
tokens.usage: Plate behind company logos that need a dark ground (9 of 39). Never a page or card fill.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of search inputs and selects. ink reads 16.0:1 on it.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of inputs, selects and the mobile filter toggle, including the business health dashboard's search, filters and measure selects. 3.7:1 on field, 3.5:1 on bg, so the field edge passes 3:1.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Fill of bordered buttons on hover, paired with a green border. On the compare tray the hover fill is green instead.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Soft panel: a category row on hover and the open Terms & sources panel in a work row. muted reads 5.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Row-label column of the compare table. muted 5.5:1, green 7.0:1 on it. The mobile layout uses #f0f3ec.

tokens.name: band-group
tokens.usage: Group band rows of the compare table (Business, Financial figures). ink 14.2:1, muted 5.4:1 on it.

tokens.name: band-rule
tokens.usage: Top rule of a compare group band.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Rule under the compare table's company header, the one rule heavier than border; also the hover border of a business health signal tile.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a chart bar in the revenue and performance charts, the business health comparison bars and the coverage bar on each signal tile. green bars read 6.4:1 against it.

tokens.name: bar-compare
tokens.usage: The comparison bar in the profile performance chart; the second bar is green. 3.8:1 on track.

tokens.name: grade-a
tokens.usage: Grade A segment of the confidence grade bar in the overview's How we check band. 9.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: grade-b
tokens.usage: Grade B segment of the grade bar. 5.3:1 on bg and 1.8:1 against grade-a; 2px bg gaps keep neighbouring segments apart.

tokens.name: grade-c
tokens.usage: Grade C segment of the grade bar. 3.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: grade-u
tokens.usage: Grade U (not confirmed) segment of the grade bar. 2.1:1 on bg, under 3:1, so the count for every grade is also printed as text.

tokens.name: figure-rule
tokens.usage: 1px dotted underline under a figure that opens its evidence; solid green on hover. 2.8:1 on bg, under 3:1, so the green figure text carries the meaning and the dots only hint.

tokens.name: mark-frame
tokens.usage: 1px frame of the S monogram in the wordmark. 3.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: dialog-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of evidence and summary dialogs.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop: dark green at 44% alpha over the page.

tokens.name: status
tokens.usage: Warm brown text of work status labels (Availability unconfirmed, Pay conflict). 5.6:1 on bg. The only status colour: the site has no red, green or blue states.

tokens.name: status-rule
tokens.usage: 2px left rule of a conflict note in a work row. 3.3:1 on bg.

tokens.name: link-status
tokens.usage: Dated link-health note (Page unavailable · 15 Oct 2026). 5.6:1 on bg.

tokens.name: favicon-ink
tokens.usage: Square of the favicon. The profile stylesheet's dark logo plate (.profile-v2 .brand-dark, used by the peer list) has the same value as a literal; it is not wired, since its role is a logo plate.

tokens.name: favicon-paper
tokens.usage: Letter of the favicon. Nowhere else.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Georgia, regular weight, tight negative tracking. Page H1s only.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Overview hero H1, ink. 38px, -1.2px at 700px and below.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page H1 on Companies, Compare, Work and Method, ink. 36px / 1.12, -1.1px at 700px and below.

styles.name: display-profile
styles.usage: Company name on a profile, ink. 36px / 1.1, -1px at 700px and below.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: System sans at 600 with light negative tracking. Statement headings end with a period; label headings do not.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Overview section titles (H2). Story titles run 27px. 25px at 700px and below.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Profile section titles and Method panel titles (H2). 23px / 1.3 at 700px and below.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Dialog titles and case study titles. 22px at 700px and below.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Default H3: method blocks, dialog sub-heads. Company names in the index run 20px / 1.3.

styles.name: heading-xs
styles.usage: Work role titles and offering titles (H3). The work list heading uses 18px / 1.25.

styles.name: heading-micro
styles.usage: H4 inside work row details and the evidence archive.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: 16px / 1.5 body on the system sans. Tabular figures everywhere: the body sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Experts create data and practice environments to train AI models.
styles.usage: Profile business summary in ink. 17px at 700px and below.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: People teach AI how to do useful work.
styles.usage: Body copy in ink; page intros use it in muted.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Each claim links to its evidence.
styles.usage: Long reading text in Method panels, ink.

styles.name: description
styles.sample: Turns professional expertise into AI training data and practice tasks.
styles.usage: One-line company and offering descriptions, muted.

styles.name: detail
styles.usage: Work row details, compare cell text, requirement bullets.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Sub-lines under figures and titles, muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart captions, axis labels, result counts, footer, muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Kind line above a figure and work row dates, muted.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Section kickers (the site's .eyebrow), muted. Capitals are typed in the copy; no text-transform.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Controls stay small and quiet: 12 to 14px labels, weight carries emphasis.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Topbar links, muted; ink when current. 12px / 1.3 at 700px and below.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Profile tabs, muted; ink when selected. 12px at 700px and below.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Primary button label. Bordered buttons use weight 500. 13px at 700px and below.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels above inputs and selects, muted.

styles.name: toggle
styles.usage: Disclosure summaries. Contextual toggles drop to 13 or 12px.

styles.name: status
styles.usage: Work status labels in the status colour.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Compare table row labels, muted, on band.

styles.name: table-group
styles.usage: Compare table group bands, ink, on band-group.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: Money and counts. Green when the figure opens its evidence, muted when historical, ink for pay.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: Profile Figures tab. 42px at 700px and below.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Overview pace snapshot. 28px at 700px and below.

styles.name: figure-compare
styles.usage: Compare table revenue cells. 25px at 700px and below.

styles.name: figure-pay
styles.usage: Pay in a work row, ink. 24px / 1.25 at 700px and below.

styles.name: figure-md
styles.usage: Company index figure. 22px at 700px and below.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Values at the end of revenue bars.

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: The wordmark lockup and its serif monogram.

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: Wordmark name, ink. 16px / 1.3 at 700px and below.

styles.name: brand-tagline
styles.usage: Wordmark tagline, muted, typed in capitals. 7px at 700px and below.

styles.name: brand-monogram
styles.usage: The S in the wordmark frame, green. The source sets font: 25px Georgia with normal line height; 23px at 700px and below.

spacing.note: No spacing variables exist in the source; every length is a literal px. These are the steps that carry the layout. Odd values (5, 7, 9, 10, 14, 18, 22, 26px) are local fixes, kept exact inside components.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Logo tile padding, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps inside small clusters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The most used step: filter row gaps, disclosure padding, mobile row gaps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Filter bar gap, gutters at 380px and below.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of hairline list rows (company, category, offering); gutters at 700px and below.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Column gap of company and offering rows; horizontal padding of compare cells.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Gap of category rows; margin under profile tabs.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gutters from 701 to 1100px; profile tab gap; section padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Page gutter above 1100px (main and topbar).

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of main; hero and Method column gap.

radius.note: Square by default. Small radii only on controls and logo plates.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Rows, sections, tabs, nav, tables: everything that is not a control.

tokens.name: radius-logo
tokens.usage: Logo plates (3px in work rows).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the primary button.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Leadership portraits and monograms only.

shadow.note: Shadows only lift things that float over the page: dialogs, the tray, open filter panels. Rows and cards never cast one.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Evidence and quick summary dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-tray
tokens.usage: The fixed compare tray.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: The open More filters panel.

tokens.name: shadow-search
tokens.usage: The site search dialog. It goes full screen with no shadow at 700px and below.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Open filter fields at 900px and below.

tokens.name: shadow-pager
tokens.usage: The mobile compare column picker.

layout.note: Page frame lengths. Breakpoints sit at 1100, 900, 700 and 380px (max-width).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Topbar height and the sticky offset for tabs and table heads. The stylesheet raises it to 100px at 700px and below.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: max-width of main, gutters included (1232px of content above 1100px).

tokens.name: hero-copy
tokens.usage: Max width of the overview hero copy column.

tokens.name: intro-max
tokens.usage: Max width of intro paragraphs.

zIndex.note: Layers, highest first. Table stickies use 2 to 5; open filter panels 30 to 35.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: Focused skip link.

tokens.name: z-tray
tokens.usage: Compare tray.

tokens.name: z-topbar
tokens.usage: Sticky topbar.

tokens.name: z-tabs
tokens.usage: Sticky profile tabs.
